review: Independent Pass B final source/regression review
reviewer: final_review agent; no source edits; local test fixtures only

findings.evidence: readingFixtures uses compile-time import.meta.env.DEV AND explicit opt-in before dynamically importing corpus; production has no allowed path even if VITE flag is true. Default empty reading UI retained. Gate/reading tests pass.
Empty group exposes reset/back action; populated-to-empty-to-back regression in hanzi-hsk tests passes.
Exam handles unsupported/no-voice/error synchronously and async onError; interrupted cancellation excluded. Errors report accessible feedback without changing answers/checkpoint.
Chinese DTO source is Jiayou; historical JMdict compatibility identifier preserved.
Generated output was excluded from reviewed source; explicit historical fixture CI remains separate from runtime packaging.

findings.area: Invisible WebGL retry after initialization failure
findings.evidence: Initially unavailable state remained true when later prop changes retried a successful renderer. Root fixed unavailableForMount ref guard and regression: constructor attempted once across mood/callback rerenders; fallback remains visible, no hidden renderer/idle loop.

additional_checks: Each returned pet/food model clones material/texture palette per model; deduplicates within that model. Concurrent canvas test confirms disposing one does not invalidate the other.

Renderer teardown deduplicates geometry/material/texture disposal and removes event/animation/media listeners. Reduced-motion branch renders without scheduling idle RAF; pointer interaction still explicit.
WebGL keyboard Enter/Space invoke interactive action and prevent scrolling; noninteractive controls do not claim button role. Fallback uses native button and compact layout.
Pinyin stepper now has 24px hit area, explicit accessible names and aria-current step; selected-step/return regression passes. Actual browser dimensions remain parent gate.

New container workflow has contents:read, builds local tags only, no registry push/remote host/service operation; isolated runs use --network none and default missing authorization. Compose checker invokes config only and asserts no host ports, external storage and validate mode.

Legacy CI fetches immutable historical commit and materializes hash-verified fixtures in runner.temp; separate Maven output avoids replacing normal test reports. Bootstrap workflow adds main validation, no deploy step.
No backend SQL/bootstrap resource diff against current main; no production credentials or host access used by this review.

executed_tests.command: node frontend/node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --root frontend [8 selected reading/audio/Hanzi/Pinyin/companion test files] --reporter=json --outputFile=.../final-review-tests.json

limitations: Approval concerns reviewed source and targeted regressions, not exhaustive security certification or live production/database compatibility.
No independent production/provider/host investigation; parent must verify deployment isolation and complete CI, browser and preservation gates.
Static corpus gate and cryptographic proof checking do not establish linguistic correctness, licensing or publication rights.
No source deletion or architecture change was performed by reviewer.
